PROJECT STONEWALL — OFFER TERMS (DRAFT 3)
Axe Capital · Deal team only · 2026-10-20

Target: Taylor Mason Capital ("TMC"), a listed alternative asset manager.

Offer: all cash, $52.75 per TMC share.
Premium: 28% to TMC's 30-day average share price of $41.20.
Equity value: about $3.2 billion on 60.7 million shares outstanding.
Structure: a tender offer for all outstanding shares, followed by a back-end merger.
Announcement: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, before the U.S. market opens.

Why Nov 10: TMC publishes its Q4 investor letter on Nov 16. Bob Adams wants the offer in front of TMC's holders before Taylor Mason can frame Q3's outflows in her own words.

Open items: financing commitment letters (see the financing note), the standstill request from TMC's counsel, and board sign-off on Nov 6.

— Bob Adams
